# PoliticsHub.in

> PoliticsHub.in publishes source-linked news briefs, news coverage and explainers on India, world affairs, politics, Maharashtra and Indian examination notices. Check individual article dates and original sources before relying on time-sensitive information.

Website: https://www.politicshub.in/
Language: English; some sections also cover Marathi and Hindi.
Editorial contact: politicshub.in@gmail.com

## Main sections
- [Home](https://www.politicshub.in/): Latest India and world headlines.
- [India](https://www.politicshub.in/india/): India news and public affairs.
- [World](https://www.politicshub.in/world/): International news and developments.
- [Politics](https://www.politicshub.in/politics/): Politics coverage.
- [Maharashtra](https://www.politicshub.in/maharashtra/): Maharashtra news.
- [India Exams](https://www.politicshub.in/exams/): Examination notices and updates.
- [Archive](https://www.politicshub.in/archive/): Browse published articles.

## Editorial information
- [About](https://www.politicshub.in/about.html): Publisher information.
- [Editorial policy](https://www.politicshub.in/editorial-policy.html): Editorial approach and sourcing.
- [Corrections](https://www.politicshub.in/corrections.html): Corrections policy and requests.
- [Contact](https://www.politicshub.in/contact.html): Contact the newsroom.
- [Sources](https://www.politicshub.in/sources.html): Source references, where available.

## Discovery
- [Sitemap index](https://www.politicshub.in/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap listing.
- [Robots instructions](https://www.politicshub.in/robots.txt): Crawler guidance.

## Usage notes
- Individual stories may change as reporting develops. Consult the publication/update time and linked original source.
- Source attribution does not imply endorsement.
- Summaries and headlines are not substitutes for primary documents, official notices or direct reporting.
- This file is informational discovery guidance, not a grant of rights to reproduce or train on site content. Consult the site's terms and applicable law.
